Ryan Potter's eight-year-old relished the step up in distance when bolting up in the Eider at Newcaslte last month and even a 10lb rise might underestimate his authority over his rivals that day. Galia Des Liteaux is a classy performer on her day and has to be respected, along with the hat-trick seeking Mr Vango.
